checks.detail: T5 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (ticket receipt, validation receipt, two independent reviews, task report, completion receipt, capital_tracker.py, test_capital_tracker_projection.py), forbids production campaign/control-plane modules, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, run_research*.py, and all non-owned tests; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All twelve input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, T1 task report/validation/completion, T2 report/completion, T3 report/completion, and T4 report/completion; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source change is research_automation/capital_tracker.py plus the new tests/test_capital_tracker_projection.py; autonomous_runner, coverage_map, run_research*.py, control-plane modules, data, KBase, strategy, policy, and user files are untouched.

CapitalTracker is constrained to analytics-only: _state_dir no longer mkdirs; save, record_experiment, record_round and _append_event fail closed with RuntimeError; aggregate_to_json returns the projection without writing agent_performance.json; the module no longer claims governance/triggering behavior.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started.

advisories.detail: aggregate_to_json is kept as a pure in-memory projection; callers that expect a cached agent_performance.json side effect must read the returned dict instead. The legacy autonomous_runner path that called it remains blocked.
load() still reads research_state/<subject>/capital_tracker.yaml when present for analytics; it never creates or writes that file.
